Overview

Coimbra is a city in Centro with a population of 143,396. A historic university city on the Mondego River, home to one of Europe’s oldest universities and a vibrant student culture. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 46.0.
